description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the distribution of participant counts across different evaluation criteria for a claim retrieval system. The vertical axis displays the evaluation criteria, labeled “Relevance Explanation,” “Clarity and Simplicity,” “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” “Veracity Explanation,” and “FC Summary,” listed in that order from bottom to top. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 2.  Each criterion is represented by a single bar of a distinct teal or purple color. The “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” bars are teal and each extend to a value of 1 on the horizontal axis. The “Overall Summary” bar is teal and extends to a value of 2. The “Relevance Explanation” and “Clarity and Simplicity” bars are a darker teal and each extend to a value of 3. The “FC Summary” bar is purple and extends to a value of 6, while the bar representing “Relevance Explanation” is purple and extends to a value of 5. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
